text: The bug is in `parse_flag`: it lowercases the input but never strips whitespace, so `"off "` doesn't match the false word set (and whitespace-only input doesn't raise either, contrary to the docstring). The fix is to strip before checking.

text: The fix is verified. The change was a one-liner in `flags/parse.py`: `text.lower()` → `text.strip().lower()`, so whitespace around the word is ignored as the docstring promises. This makes `"off "` parse as `False` (previously `True`), and also makes whitespace-only input correctly raise `ValueError` as documented. All existing tests pass.
